crossRefs.note: My steps have held fast to your paths. My feet have not slipped.
Righteousness goes before him, And prepares the way for his steps.
Establish my footsteps in your word. Don’t let any iniquity have dominion over me.
He will not allow your foot to be moved. He who keeps you will not slumber.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.
He will keep the feet of his holy ones, but the wicked will be put to silence in darkness; for no man will prevail by…
My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary…
A man’s heart plans his course, but Yahweh directs his steps.
Yahweh, I know that the way of man is not in himself. It is not in man who walks to direct his steps.
He brought me up also out of a horrible pit, out of the miry clay. He set my feet on a rock, and gave me a firm place…
Make the path of your feet level. Let all of your ways be established.
He doesn’t delight in the strength of the horse. He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
A false balance is an abomination to Yahweh, but accurate weights are his delight.
Those who are perverse in heart are an abomination to Yahweh, but those whose ways are blameless are his delight.
But let him who glories glory in this, that he has understanding, and knows me, that I am Yahweh who exercises loving…
But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

translations.web: A man’s steps are established by Yahweh. He delights in his way.
translations.bsb: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
translations.kjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the LORD: and he delighteth in his way.
translations.asv: A man's goings are established of Jehovah; And he delighteth in his way.
